vector_memory.semantic_summary: QuadPrimitive is a concrete implementation of a geometric primitive, extending MeshData to represent a flat, square plane. Its constructor procedurally generates all necessary rendering data—vertices, normals, UVs, and indices—for a quad centered at the origin. It utilizes a private helper function, addFace, to construct the geometry by defining two constituent triangles, supporting instantiation via an optional size parameter.
